title: Amsterdamse omnibus-enquête II 1983
authors: Cornelisse-Claassen, T.M., Gemeente Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Bestuursinformatie, afd. onderzoek en statistiek (primary investigator)
contributors: Gemeente Amsterdam, Afd. bestuursinformatie * Amsterdam (research initiator)
Gemeente Amsterdam, Afd. bestuursinformatie, enquêteAfd. * Amsterdam (data collector)
descriptions: To improve efficiency in performance of municipal departments. Experience with public works and projects with regard to traffic in the city of Amsterdam / wishes regarding traffic / travelling by underground / changes in bus and tram routes / plans to move: preferred location and type of residence / personal finances / making use of health services, including alternative treatment. Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ income/capital assets/ education
